details.biography: With over 10 years of experience, Conor Deedigan is a director, editor and camera operator. He has directed and shot content for top leading brands such as Canon, Greenpeace, Tottenham Hotspur football club, and The BBC.A film he wrote, produced and directed, won Best British Drama at The Discover Film Award's 2018 . His insight into film, and other forms of artwork, help him to visually express the atmosphere, mood and themes of the piece.Conor enjoys working within a team on large and small projects as well as leading his own team in his own creative projects. Conor has knowledge of the entire film process having worked on major blockbusters such as StarWars, Wonder Woman, and James Bond. Conor has a flare for creative ideas and problem solving.He has highly effective time management and organisational skills and prides himself on his ability to work well with others and remain claim and positive under pressure.In 2022 Conor spearheaded a project for The Rank Prize Fund. This included working from a treatment he designed and touring the country interviewing a wide range of world renowned and highly prestigious scientists such as Sir David Payne and Professor Shuji Nakamura. Working closely with a team of camera operators both in the UK and the US, Conor successfully directed, edited and delivered ‘The Rank Prize Fund’s 50th Anniversary Film’ for CTVC and The Rank Prize Fund.
details.name: Conor Deedigan
